column1: IDFC Ltd. has been included in Nifty Financial Services index as the average free-float market capitalization
of company is more than 1.5 times the average free-float market capitalization of the smallest constituent i.e.
Indian Energy Exchange Ltd. representing ‘Other Financial Services’ in the index. Other Financial Services
currently comprise all companies in Financial Services sector excluding companies in banking, financial
institutions, housing finance, insurance and NBFCs.
